MARCH 17 • BEYONDTHEFLAG.COM Wins In Vegas Hamlin picked up his first NASCAR Cup Series win of the 2026 season in Sunday's Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway. Impact It was a dominant performance by Hamlin, who qualified second and led 134 of the 267 laps, including the final 49 laps of the day on his way to the checkered flag. It was Hamlin's third Cup Series victory at Las Vegas Motor Speedway and his second in a row after winning at the track last October. The series now heads to Darlington Raceway, where Hamlin has been dominant across his career with five wins and 20 Top 10s in 27 Cup Series races, including a win at the track last spring.
